subject: laughing kookaburra
title: This Laughing Bird Kills Snakes by Smashing Them Against Branches

scenes.text: Australia's famous laughing bird hunts snakes with no venom and no talons.
The laughing kookaburra is the biggest kingfisher, yet it weighs under half a kilo.
It waits on a perch, then drops onto a snake and grabs it behind the head.
Then it beats the snake against a branch, again and again. Sometimes it drops it from a height.
Zoos report it can take snakes up to a meter long. It swallows them whole, head first.
That famous laugh is a call to defend its territory. Snakes are on the menu.

description:
The laughing kookaburra, the largest kingfisher at under half a kilogram, kills snakes and lizards by grabbing them behind the head and beating them against a branch or the ground, sometimes dropping them from a height.
Zoos report it can take snakes up to about 1 m (3 ft) long, swallowing them head first. Its famous laugh is a territorial call.
Which bird would you least want to be a snake around?
first_comment: Kookaburras live in family groups, and the young from last year help raise the new chicks. Have you ever heard one laugh in real life?
